mechanics.name: Dark Mending
mechanics.note: His Flamewaker Priests heal him back up. Every one that goes through is a minute of the pull given away.

mechanics.name: Hand of Ragnaros
mechanics.note: Knocks back and stuns everyone near him; melee eat it, ranged should not be in range at all.

mechanics.name: Flame Spear
mechanics.note: Thrown at one player and scorching everyone near them; spread so it only catches its target.
